criterion_tex: QR33+ strictly improves original QR33 loss within the 45 originally adverse panel cells.\par\emph{Threshold:} At least 40 of fixed 45 cells.
QR33+ excess loss against F lies within inclusive [-10\%,\allowbreak{} +10\%].\par\emph{Threshold:} At least 36 of fixed 48 cells within [-10,\allowbreak{} +10]\%.
Selected ridge penalty is at least 1.\par\emph{Threshold:} At least 25 of fixed 48 cells (more than half).

All 26 retrospective weekly R2 cells complete with bounded worst and median excess.\par\emph{Threshold:} 26/\allowbreak{}26 complete; worst \ensuremath{<}=\allowbreak{} +25\%; median \ensuremath{<}=\allowbreak{} +5\%.

R2 retains at least half of each negative R0 FX H6 gain.\par\emph{Threshold:} For each eligible R0 \ensuremath{<} 0 cell,\allowbreak{} R2 \ensuremath{<}=\allowbreak{} 0.5*R0; at least one eligible cell required.
R2 weekly median excess is strictly lower than R0.\par\emph{Threshold:} Both rules complete 26 cells; median(R2) \ensuremath{<} median(R0).
At W52, the QR33 median with constant parameters is near parity with F.\par\emph{Threshold:} Inclusive [-5,\allowbreak{} +5]\%.
At W52, the QR33 median with switching parameters exceeds the constant-parameter median by 5 pp.\par\emph{Threshold:} Switching minus constant \ensuremath{>}=\allowbreak{} +5 pp.

Both group medians improve and at least 12 of 13 sources improve in both groups.\par\emph{Threshold:} Both group medians strictly lower; joint improvement \ensuremath{>}=\allowbreak{} 12/\allowbreak{}13.
Realized better historical report min(F,\allowbreak{} I) strictly beats QR33.\par\emph{Threshold:} At least 60\% of all 2K cells; no missing operand deletion.
Each W QR33 median excess against F lies near parity.\par\emph{Threshold:} Inclusive [-10,\allowbreak{} +10]\% at both W52 and W260.
QR4 median excess is strictly lower with W260 than W52.\par\emph{Threshold:} W260 median \ensuremath{<} W52 median.

Strictly positive finite-menu oracle gap G in more than half of fixed 41 short-weekly cells.\par\emph{Threshold:} Fixed 41 denominator; positive G share \ensuremath{>} 1/\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{} using missing bounds.

Positive actual excess E and selection component S \ensuremath{>} E/\allowbreak{}2 in more than half of fixed 41 cells.\par\emph{Threshold:} Fixed 41 denominator; share of E \ensuremath{>} 0 and S \ensuremath{>} E/\allowbreak{}2 \ensuremath{>} 1/\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{} using missing bounds.
Both original long-history FX horizons have negative finite-menu gap.\par\emph{Threshold:} G \ensuremath{<} 0 at H6 and H24; conjunction of both original FX cells.

At each W, longer CFTC validation reduces the across-contract QR33 median by at least 5 pp.\par\emph{Threshold:} For each W52/\allowbreak{}W260: median(V156)-median(V52) \ensuremath{<}=\allowbreak{} -5 pp; both required.
Longer CFTC validation raises empirical-limit selection frequency at each W.\par\emph{Threshold:} At each W52/\allowbreak{}W260: infinity count(V156) \ensuremath{>} count(V52); both required.
At tau .99 F strictly beats QR33 in at least 29 fixed CFTC cells.\par\emph{Threshold:} At least 29/\allowbreak{}34; strict wins only; fixed denominator with unknown bounds.
At tau .99 QR33 improves matched F in both FX periods.\par\emph{Threshold:} Relative excess \ensuremath{<} 0 in original and early 2015; both required.

At each horizon, longer New York Fed validation reduces the median across 13 series by at least 5 pp.\par\emph{Threshold:} At each H6/\allowbreak{}H24: median(V156)-median(V52) \ensuremath{<}=\allowbreak{} -5 pp; both required.
Longer NY Fed validation increases empirical-limit selections at each horizon.\par\emph{Threshold:} At each H6/\allowbreak{}H24: infinity count(V156) \ensuremath{>} count(V52); both required.

Protocol median excess is small across all 60 eligible weekly cells.\par\emph{Threshold:} Full-universe median \ensuremath{<}=\allowbreak{} +1\%; any eligible missing outcome =\allowbreak{}\ensuremath{>} UNDETERMINED.

At most 5\% of eligible weekly cells lose more than 10\% against F.\par\emph{Threshold:} Adverse defined excess \ensuremath{>} 10\%; adverse fraction \ensuremath{<}=\allowbreak{} 0.05; at most 3 of 60.

Retain at least half of ordinary QR gain in every eligible FX period.\par\emph{Threshold:} If ordinary excess \ensuremath{<} 0,\allowbreak{} RP excess \ensuremath{<}=\allowbreak{} 0.5*ordinary; every eligible gain period and at least 1 required.
Low-region QR4 strictly loses against matched F.\par\emph{Threshold:} At least 80\% of fixed 17 low-region cells; combined P1 requires both methods.
Low-region QR33 strictly loses against matched F.\par\emph{Threshold:} At least 80\% of fixed 34 low-region cells; combined P1 requires both methods.
High-region W520 QR4 strictly beats matched F.\par\emph{Threshold:} At least 60\% of fixed 17 high-region cells.
QR33 high-region comparison requires observed c \ensuremath{>} 2 r*.\par\emph{Threshold:} No registered high-region cell exists; structurally NOT\_\allowbreak{}TESTABLE by design.
QR4 excess loss strictly decreases at both successive history steps.\par\emph{Threshold:} At least 70\% of fixed 17 markets satisfy Delta 52 \ensuremath{>} Delta 260 \ensuremath{>} Delta 520.

Strictly positive finite-menu oracle gap G in more than half of fixed 41 short-weekly cells.\par\emph{Threshold:} Fixed 41 denominator; positive G share \ensuremath{>} 1/\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{} using missing bounds.

Positive actual excess E and selection component S \ensuremath{>} E/\allowbreak{}2 in more than half of fixed 41 cells.\par\emph{Threshold:} Fixed 41 denominator; share of E \ensuremath{>} 0 and S \ensuremath{>} E/\allowbreak{}2 \ensuremath{>} 1/\allowbreak{}2,\allowbreak{} using missing bounds.
Both original long-history FX horizons have negative finite-menu gap.\par\emph{Threshold:} G \ensuremath{<} 0 at H6 and H24; conjunction of both original FX cells.

At each W, longer CFTC validation reduces the across-contract QR4 median by at least 5 pp.\par\emph{Threshold:} For each W52/\allowbreak{}W260: median(V156)-median(V52) \ensuremath{<}=\allowbreak{} -5 pp; both required.
Longer CFTC validation raises empirical-limit selection frequency at each W.\par\emph{Threshold:} At each W52/\allowbreak{}W260: infinity count(V156) \ensuremath{>} count(V52); both required.

At each horizon, longer New York Fed validation reduces the median across 13 series by at least 5 pp.\par\emph{Threshold:} At each H6/\allowbreak{}H24: median(V156)-median(V52) \ensuremath{<}=\allowbreak{} -5 pp; both required.
Longer NY Fed validation increases empirical-limit selections at each horizon.\par\emph{Threshold:} At each H6/\allowbreak{}H24: infinity count(V156) \ensuremath{>} count(V52); both required.
